query: My Nexa X1 has a floating circle that constantly hovers on my screen and gives me quick shortcuts to recent apps, home, back, screen off, volume control, and more; I want to remove it.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Multi Window Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Multi window fix

actions.description: It will customize the quick access panel

steps: Customize the panel, download new panels.
Remove apps from the panel if needed.
To find the panel, swipe left on the gray Quick Access panel handle, which is located on the right side of your screen.
Use the Settings, All apps, and Edit icons at the bottom of the panel to adjust your desired options.
Open in split screen view: Open the app in split screen view.
Move the icon around the screen.
Make more than one app into an icon.
Maximize window: Expand the app back into its regular full-screen view.
Close app: Close the current pop-up view window.

actions.description: It will remove shortcuts from application edge

steps: From any screen, swipe left on the Quick Access panel.
Tap the minus icon next to the shortcuts you want to remove.
Add the shortcut back later, or add new Quick Access panels with additional apps that you'd like to use.
